arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
DATE = "September 6, 2026"
INPUT = "report.pdf"
COVER = "cover.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

width, height = letter  # 612 x 792, matches report.pdf page size
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)

# Decorative rules near the top
c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.2, 0.35, 0.55)
c.setLineWidth(2)
c.line(72, height - 160, width - 72, height - 160)
c.setLineWidth(0.75)
c.line(72, height - 168, width - 72, height - 168)

# Title (centered)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.1, 0.15, 0.25)
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 300, TITLE)

# Subtitle
c.setFillColorRGB(0.35, 0.4, 0.5)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 14)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 330, "Fiscal Year 2024")

# Current date (centered near bottom)
c.setFillColorRGB(0.2, 0.25, 0.35)
c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, 130, DATE)

c.save()
print("Created cover.pdf")

# Prepend the cover to report.pdf
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)
report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT)
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in report_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Created {OUTPUT} with {len(writer.pages)} page(s) total")
EOF
